message_text: What are the prerequisites for Organic Chemistry?
CHEM 301 (Organic Chemistry I) requires completion of CHEM 101 and CHEM 102 with a grade of C or better.
I got a C- in CHEM 102. Can I still take it?
Unfortunately, a C- does not meet the prerequisite requirement. You would need to retake CHEM 102 and earn a C or better.
OK understood. When is CHEM 102 offered again?
CHEM 102 is offered every Fall and Spring semester, with limited Summer sessions.
